FIELDS.NAME: Luminous Lighting Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Luminous Lighting Solutions specializes in the retail sale of a wide variety of lighting fixtures, bulbs, and accessories. Our primary focus is on providing an exceptional in-person shopping experience through our physical storefront, ensuring that customers can interact with our knowledgeable staff and explore our diverse product range. While we do offer a limited selection of installation services, these comprise less than 10% of our total revenue, allowing us to maintain a strong retail focus. We ensure compliance with safety standards mandated by Underwriters Laboratories (UL) and the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) to guarantee the quality and safety of our products. Our inventory is securely stored in a monitored facility, and we implement rigorous inventory management controls to mitigate any risk of loss. This ensures we can provide timely service to our customers while adhering to our commitment to quality and safety. With a strong emphasis on maintaining vendor relationships, we source our inventory from reputable manufacturers and distributors, ensuring a consistent and reliable supply of high-quality lighting solutions for both residential and commercial customers.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not exceed 10% of total revenue from on-site installation or repair services and confirms that no more than 75% of total revenue is generated from online sales. Additionally, we maintain a centralized alarm system at all physical storefronts and have implemented regular inventory management controls, including cycle counts and secured storage, to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses due to theft of inventory occurred on March 5, 2023, resulting in a loss of $5,000. The incident is currently under investigation, with security measures being reviewed to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Centralized alarm system in place, regular patrols conducted by security personnel during operating hours, and secure fencing around the perimeter of the property.
